title: Guided Umrah Pilgrimage
summary: Ten nights across Mecca and Medina, with the flights, entry permits, and accommodation handled in advance — so the only thing you have to plan for is the pilgrimage itself.
highlights: A pre-departure orientation on the rites of Umrah
Hotel walking distance from Masjid al-Haram in Mecca
Hotel walking distance from the Prophet's Mosque in Medina
A group departure, traveling together throughout

itinerary.title: Depart & arrive in Medina
itinerary.description: Group flight departure, arriving in Medina for two days of prayer at the Prophet's Mosque.

itinerary.title: Medina to Mecca
itinerary.description: Road transfer to Mecca and six nights within walking distance of Masjid al-Haram for Umrah and daily prayer.

itinerary.title: Final rites
itinerary.description: A closing day for any remaining rites and personal time near the Haram.

itinerary.title: Depart
itinerary.description: Group transfer to Jeddah for the return flight.

included: 9 nights across two hotels, both walking distance from the Haramain
Return group flights and all ground transfers
Umrah visa and entry permit processing
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
